messages:
samir: Quick heads-up — nightly CI traces spiked ~3x last run, nsys artifacts ~12GB :grimacing:

nora_li: Saw that. I pulled the trace bundle. Looks like nsys did almost full capture for long sequences because our sampler flipped to greedy on a few noisy jobs.

alex_m: Where's the sampler config live so we can tweak?

samir: repo: infra/ci/perf-traces/sampler.yaml

samir: Current config snapshot I grabbed: `stratified: false`, `min_probability: 0.02`, `max_per_job: 5000`

julia: That's the issue — long tail sequences dominate when stratified=false. Suggest stratified sampling + kv-hotness weighting. Quick proposal below.

julia: ```yaml
sampler:
  mode: stratified
  buckets:
    - name: short
      max_len: 128
      p: 0.02
    - name: medium
      max_len: 1024
      p: 0.10
    - name: long
      min_len: 1025
      p: 0.50
  weight_by: ["kv_cache_miss_rate", "kernel_runtime_variance"]
  max_artifact_per_job: 800
```

nora_li: Also add `nsys --sample-reduction-policy` and perfetto filters to avoid capturing long idle kernel timelines from synthetic tests. We should exclude low-event NVTX regions before upload.

alex_m: Good call. Can we gate uploads to avoid 10+ GB artifacts? e.g., fail the job and upload a minimal triage package instead of the full trace.

samir: Proposed plan: 1) enable stratified sampler + kv weighting; 2) add pre-upload pruning that drops nvtx ranges with low event density; 3) if final artifact > 4GB, generate a "diff summary" and a minimal kernel timeline capture, upload both instead of full raw.

perf-ci-bot: Action created: PERF-1234 — update ci sampler config + add pre-upload pruning. Assignee: @nora_li. Due: 3d. :white_check_mark:

julia: I'll add a cheap perfetto pass that only emits kernel runtime histograms and top-k kernel stacks (no full GPU trace). That should preserve signal for kernel-selection/regression checks.

nora_li: I'll update the DAG: `ci/perf-job` -> `run-nsys (sampled)` -> `analyze` -> if size>4GB -> `run-prune` -> `upload pruned + summary`. Also propose S3 lifecycle: move full raw to Glacier after 30d and keep summaries for 180d.

alex_m: Let's add a regression gate on kernel p95 latency diffs and wire it to the diff dashboard. If p95 > +10% we auto-open an issue with attached top kernels.

samir: Agree. Gate: kernel_p95_delta > 10% triggers investigation. Auto-attach top-5 kernels and the perf summary.

julia: I'll draft the PR and include a small test harness that generates synthetic kv-hot sequences to validate sampler weighting. cc @samir @nora_li

samir: :thumbsup: Thanks — aim to flip the config on next nightly run and monitor upload sizes/CI cost.
